answer: PoA resists Sybil expansion by binding every identity to a bonded collateral escrow and tracking its signing behavior. If k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated evidence makes the aggregate slashing obligation scale as O(k²). Upon detecting the swarm, asymmetric depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, so a ridge, garden, or falcon of aliases cannot cheaply dilute accountability: shared control concentrates risk rather than multiplying influence.
